classification.difficultyReason: Use the supplied decomposition lines to calculate rectangle and triangle areas, then decide whether to add the triangle or subtract the notch.

content.prompt: Calculate the area of these composite shapes.

spec.description: A composite quadrilateral with vertical sides and a top edge sloping down to the right. A horizontal dashed decomposition line separates a lower rectangle from an upper triangle. All three source right-angle markers are retained.
spec.mathematics: The rectangle is 7 m wide and 5 m high. The triangle above it has base 7 m and perpendicular height 3 m.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and construction marks are visible; the supplied result is stored in the part answer.

answer.worked:
Add the areas of the rectangle and triangle.
$$\begin{align*}
A_{\text{rectangle}} &= 7\times5\\
A_{\text{rectangle}} &= 35\ \text{m}^2\\
A_{\text{triangle}} &= \frac12\times7\times3\\
A_{\text{triangle}} &= 10.5\ \text{m}^2\\
A &= A_{\text{rectangle}}+A_{\text{triangle}}\\
A &= 35+10.5\\
A &= 45.5\ \text{m}^2
\end{align*}$$

spec.description: A rectangle with a downward triangular notch removed from its top. The original top and notch altitude are dashed. Matching single ticks mark the vertical sides; matching double ticks mark both halves of the original top and the notch altitude. Three right-angle markers are retained. The measured region has a restrained light-blue fill and the excluded notch remains white.
spec.mathematics: The enclosing rectangle is 10 cm wide and 9 cm high. The removed triangle has base 10 cm and perpendicular height 5 cm. Each half of the top and the notch altitude has equal length.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens, equality marks and construction lines are visible; the supplied result is stored in the part answer.

answer.worked:
Subtract the triangular notch from the rectangle.
$$\begin{align*}
A_{\text{rectangle}} &= 10\times9\\
A_{\text{rectangle}} &= 90\ \text{cm}^2\\
A_{\text{triangle}} &= \frac12\times10\times5\\
A_{\text{triangle}} &= 25\ \text{cm}^2\\
A &= A_{\text{rectangle}}-A_{\text{triangle}}\\
A &= 90-25\\
A &= 65\ \text{cm}^2
\end{align*}$$
